name: Analyze TikTok keyword videos for content ideas with BeatAPI Social Data

parameters.content:
# Analyze TikTok keyword videos for content ideas with BeatAPI Social Data

This workflow turns public TikTok keyword video search results into a cited content idea brief. Set a keyword in **Configure Inputs** and run it manually. BeatAPI Social Data searches related videos from the past month with US defaults. A field projection keeps the response compact; the workflow retains up to 12 identifiable video IDs, descriptions, authors and links. A BeatAPI text model drafts recurring content angles and cites specific videos.

To set it up, [create a BeatAPI key](https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys) and add an n8n **HTTP Header Auth** credential: header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your BeatAPI key>`. Select that credential in both BeatAPI HTTP Request nodes. Choose a text model available to your account. Each run uses BeatAPI credits for one Social Data call and one text-model call. See the [TikTok API page](https://beatapi.io/tiktok-api), [BeatAPI website](https://beatapi.io/) and [Social Data action catalog](https://docs.beatapi.io/social-data-catalog).

This template uses `tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_search_result`. It reads public search metadata only; it does not sign in, watch videos, fetch transcripts or post to TikTok. The sampled results are not a platform-wide trend report, and creator descriptions should be checked against the cited videos.

## 1. Set the keyword

Replace `keyword` with the TikTok topic you want to research. The video search defaults to US, the past month and relatedness. Adjust `region`, `publish_time` and `sort_type` in the first HTTP node if needed. Set an available BeatAPI text model in Configure Inputs.

## 2. Keep source evidence

Calls `data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_search_result` in preview mode with a field projection. Keeps up to 12 identifiable public videos, descriptions, URLs and the BeatAPI request ID. An empty or unrecognizable response stops with an explicit error.

## 3. Draft and verify

The model produces a cited TikTok content idea brief from search metadata. Verify each cited video before sharing conclusions. Descriptions are creator claims; the workflow has not watched or transcribed the clips and the sample is not a platform-wide trend report.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { reference: 'data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_search_result', input: { keyword: $json.keyword, region: 'US', publish_time: 30, sort_type: 0, count: 20, offset: 0 }, view: 'preview', max_items: 12, fields: ['status', 'request_id', 'object', 'items[].aweme_info.aweme_id', 'items[].aweme_info.desc', 'items[].aweme_info.author.unique_id', 'items[].aweme_info.share_url', 'items[].aweme_info.statistics.play_count', 'items[].aweme_info.statistics.digg_count', 'items[].aweme_info.statistics.comment_count', 'items[].aweme_info.create_time'] } }}

={{ { model: $('Configure Inputs').first().json.model, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: "Create a short TikTok keyword video content brief from sampled public search metadata. Identify repeated video angles, creator phrasing, and 3 concrete video examples with an ID or URL citation for each. Treat descriptions and counts as unverified, point-in-time metadata. Do not claim you watched the videos, read transcripts, or measured platform-wide trends. If evidence is thin, say so." }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] } }}
